# Theme 1: Modern Sleek

**Palette:** bg `#F5F5F7`, card `#FFFFFF`, text `#1D1D1F`, muted `#6E6E73`, line `#E5E5EA`, accent `#0071E3` → `#5E5CE6` (gradient), warn bg `#FFF8E6` / line `#FFD60A`. Dark: bg `#0B0B0F`, card `#16161C`, text `#F5F5F7`, muted `#98989F`, line `#2A2A32`, accent `#2997FF`.

**Typography:** system stack (`-apple-system, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", Roboto, Inter, sans-serif`); title 2.4rem/700 with tight -0.02em tracking; body 16px/1.6; mono `ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo`.

**Layout:** single centered column (680px), generous whitespace, frosted-glass section cards with a step-number badge, soft large radius (20px).

**Visual elements:** subtle accent gradient on the title and install button (pill shaped), soft layered shadows instead of heavy borders, hairline 1px borders, backdrop blur, gentle hover lift.
